chosen_titles.rationale: Chapter 120C - Lobbying: the standalone post-2006 ethics-reform lobbying chapter holding the lobbyist registration, reporting, gift, and enforcement provisions.

notes: NC consolidated its lobbying-disclosure regime into standalone Chapter 120C via the 2006 State Government Ethics Act / lobbying-reform package; pre-2006 Article 9A of Chapter 120 (General Assembly) is no longer the operative regime by 2015. Chapter 138A (State Government Ethics Act) is the officials-side ethics regime (out of scope: not lobbying-disclosure).
